full_prompt_en: A square fantastical natural-history painting shows three small pale-faced mustelids clustered on a stone ledge beside a dense bouquet of wild flowers. The background is a dark brown-green twilight field with a low amber glow on the right, suggesting distant open air without a detailed horizon. A tall flowering stem rises from the lower left through the middle, carrying pink, coral, cream, and buttery yellow blossoms, green leaves, and fine reddish seed heads. Behind the bouquet and slightly above the others, the largest animal lifts its head to the upper center and looks toward the right. Its cream face has a dark eye patch, black nose, small rounded ears, and brown fur fading into shadow around the chest. Two smaller animals sit close together below it, both turned toward the right and partly overlapping. Their pale muzzles and glossy dark eyes are the clearest points against a mass of dark fur and leaves. One small paw rests on the rough ledge at the lower center. Flowers weave between the animals rather than sitting in a separate vase, their warm colors emerging from deep foliage. The ledge is chipped gray-brown stone with scattered leaves and broken stems along the bottom edge. Fur is rendered with soft, fine strokes, while petals and stems are painted with tighter bright accents. The atmosphere is still and carefully staged, with only faint hints of distant grasses at the right. Warm side light from the right and slightly above catches the faces, ears, and upper blossoms, leaving the lower bodies and left background in deep shadow. The overall composition is a compact triangular grouping of animal faces and flowers, set against a broad dark field that makes the pale details glow.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、带幻想气息的博物绘画呈现三只浅脸小型鼬科动物聚在石台上，旁边是一束密集野花。背景是深棕绿色暮色场，右侧有低低的琥珀色微光，暗示远处开放空气，却没有详细地平线。一束高花茎从左下升向中央，承载粉、珊瑚、奶油和奶油黄色花朵、绿叶及纤细红色籽穗。最大的一只动物在花束后、其他两只上方抬头，位于上方中央，朝右看。它的奶油色脸上有深色眼斑、黑鼻、小圆耳，棕毛在胸口周围淡入暗处。两只较小动物在它下方紧贴而坐，都转向右且局部互相遮挡。浅色口鼻和发亮深眼是深色毛皮与叶片团块中最清楚的亮点。一只小爪落在下方中央粗糙石台上。花在动物之间交织，并不独立插在花瓶里，暖色花朵从深枝叶中浮出。台面为缺口不齐的灰棕石头，底边散着叶片和折断的茎。毛皮由柔和细笔表现，花瓣和花茎则用更紧密的亮色强调描绘。气氛静止、经营周到，右侧只有远草的模糊暗示。暖侧光从右上方照到脸、耳和上方花朵，下半身体及左侧背景留在深影里。整体构图由动物脸与花构成紧凑三角群，置于宽阔暗场前，使浅色细节发亮。
style_prompt_en: The richly detailed painterly treatment gathers finely observed pale focal surfaces and warm floral color inside a deep umber-green setting. Soft fur-like strokes, precise petal edges, and rough stone-like patches are differentiated without breaking the coherent matte finish. Cream, peach, rose, amber, and muted gold glow against olive, brown-black, and forest green. A small cluster of bright rounded forms sits low and slightly off center, with taller narrow accents rising beside it. Directional warm light grazes the upper and outward-facing planes, while lower masses merge into layered shadow. Background detail is sparse, giving the dense foreground texture room to stand forward. The overall effect is intimate, ornate, and gently mysterious.
style_prompt_zh: 这种细节丰富的绘画处理把观察准确的浅色焦点表面和暖花色聚在深棕绿色环境中。柔软毛发般笔触、准确花瓣边和粗石般色片各有区别，却没有破坏统一的哑光完成面。奶油、桃、玫瑰、琥珀及暗金在橄榄、棕黑与森林绿前发亮。一小簇明亮圆润形状位于偏低、略偏一侧的位置，旁边升起高窄强调。暖定向光掠过朝上和向外的平面，下方大块融入层叠阴影。背景细节稀疏，让密集前景肌理能够向前浮出。整体效果亲近、华丽，带轻柔神秘感。
theme_en: Three small mustelids among flowers at dusk
theme_zh: 暮色中三只小型鼬科动物围在花旁
name: Martin Wittfooth
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
